name: Electric Charge
description: Electric charge is the fundamental property of matter that causes it to experience a force in an electromagnetic field.

name: Electric Current
description: Electric current is the flow of electric charge through a conductor, measured in amperes.

name: Electric Potential (Voltage)
description: Electric potential is the amount of electric potential energy per unit charge at a point in an electric field.

name: Ohm's Law
description: Ohm's Law states that the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the voltage across it.

name: Electrical Resistance
description: Electrical resistance is the opposition to the flow of electric current, measured in ohms.

name: Electrical Resistivity
description: Electrical resistivity is a material's inherent resistance to electric current flow, independent of shape and size.

name: Series Resistors
description: Series resistors are connected end-to-end, causing the same current to flow through each resistor.

name: Parallel Resistors
description: Parallel resistors are connected across the same two points, causing the voltage across each to be the same.

name: Voltage Divider
description: A voltage divider is a circuit that divides the input voltage proportionally using resistors.

name: Current Divider
description: A current divider is a circuit that divides the input current proportionally using parallel resistors.

name: Electrical Power in Resistors
description: Electrical power in resistors is the rate at which electrical energy is converted to heat, measured in watts.

name: Electrical Energy in Resistors
description: Electrical energy in resistors is the total electrical work done over time, measured in joules.

name: Kirchhoff's Current Law
description: Kirchhoff's Current Law states that the sum of currents entering a junction equals the sum of currents leaving it.

name: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law
description: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law states that the sum of voltage drops around a closed loop equals the sum of voltage sources.

name: RLC Circuits
description: RLC circuits contain resistors, inductors, and capacitors, creating complex AC circuit behavior.

name: Electrical Power
description: Electrical power is the rate of electrical energy transfer, calculated as voltage times current.

name: Complex Network Analysis
description: Complex network analysis is the systematic method of solving intricate electrical circuits using multiple techniques.

name: Electrical Impedance
description: Electrical impedance is the total opposition to alternating current flow, combining resistance and reactance.

name: Electrical Reactance
description: Electrical reactance is the opposition to alternating current caused by inductors and capacitors.

name: Electrical Resonance
description: Electrical resonance occurs when inductive and capacitive reactances are equal, maximizing circuit response.

name: Transformer Principle
description: Transformers operate on electromagnetic induction to transfer electrical energy between circuits.

name: Electrical Generation
description: Electrical generation is the process of producing electrical energy from mechanical energy.

name: Electrical Distribution
description: Electrical distribution is the transmission of electrical power from generation plants to consumers.

name: Electrical Safety Procedures
description: Electrical safety procedures prevent accidents and injuries when working with electrical systems and equipment.
